US.description: Cost of living index (excluding rent) covering groceries, transportation, utilities, dining, and personal care for a moderate lifestyle across the US.

IN.description: Cost of living excluding rent is significantly lower than Western countries, covering groceries, local transportation, utilities, and mid-range dining. Values are based on major Indian cities.

SG.description: Extremely high cost of living for daily expenses, groceries, and leisure.

CH.description: Very high cost for groceries, public transportation, dining out, and personal services across the country.

NL.description: Cost of living for a single person, excluding rent, covering groceries, transportation, utilities, and leisure.

GB.description: Includes groceries, transportation, utilities, and leisure activities, with higher costs in London and major cities.

CA.description: Includes groceries, local transportation, utilities, dining, and personal care items for a typical single person.

AE.description: High cost of living, particularly for dining, entertainment, and imported goods. Utilities and transportation costs can be moderate depending on usage and location.

NO.description: High costs for groceries, transportation, and dining out. Utilities are moderate.

IE.description: High cost of living, particularly for groceries, utilities, and transportation in urban centers.

LU.description: Luxembourg has a high cost of living, particularly for groceries, dining out, transportation, and personal services. Utilities are also notably expensive.

AU.description: Cost of living, excluding rent, is generally high, with groceries, utilities, transportation, and leisure activities being notably expensive across major Australian cities.

QA.description: Moderate cost of living excluding rent, covering groceries, transportation, and utilities.

BN.description: Cost of living is moderately high, particularly for imported goods, but local services and certain staples are more affordable.

MO.description: High cost for daily necessities, groceries, and dining due to reliance on imports and a service-heavy economy.
